name: @w6w-apps/webinarjam
description: Read webinars, register attendees, list registrants and unsubscribe leads across WebinarJam (live) and EverWebinar (automated replay).

w6w.longDescription:
WebinarJam runs live webinars and EverWebinar runs their automated, on-a-schedule replays — the same vendor, the same account-wide API key, and (per the vendor's own developer docs) an identical five-endpoint surface reachable at two path prefixes on one host. This app covers both from a single connection: list the webinars published in an account, read one webinar's schedules/presenters/registration links, register an attendee (including a webinar's own custom registration fields, passed through by their configured label), list registrants and attendees with the vendor's attendance/purchase/date-range filters, and unsubscribe a lead from further notifications.

Every action takes a `product` selector (`webinarjam` or `everwebinar`) rather than being duplicated per product, because the vendor's docs state the two share one API key and one field shape — only the path prefix differs.

API access itself is gated: WebinarJam requires manually applying for API access (Profile > API, ~2 business days, paid plans only) before any key exists, so there is no self-serve credential to connect with immediately after installing this app.
